name: Rules Related to Madhya Pradesh State Disease Assistance Fund
benefit:
- Financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹2,00,000 for major surgeries or medical interventions.

> **NOTE:** 

1. The SIF assistance amount cheque is provided directly to the Hospital/Institution where the approved case (patient) is referred.
1. The grant will be permissible for the recognized hospitals within the state & outside the state. 
1. For cancer cases, the grant will be given
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a domicile of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant must be suffering from a [disease listed](https://www.health.mp.gov.in/sites/default/files/siaf-approved-rate-list-2018.pdf) among the approved illnesses under the scheme.1. The hospital must be a recognized institution within or outside Madhya Pradesh. 1. Only one eligible family member can receive assistance once.
